_comment: Runtime configuration of the Indic Voice SDK. Ship this file with the app (assets) or fetch it from your CDN; change behaviour here without touching code. Nothing in this file is a secret, so it never needs ENV variables.

stt._comment: tierPolicy: DEVICE_FIRST (1→2→3), DEVICE_ONLY (1→2), HOSTED_FIRST (3→1→2), HOSTED_ONLY (3), ORDER (use tierOrder as given)

languageId._comment: Auto mode: the spoken language is identified from the AUDIO (multilingual Whisper, ~0.1-0.3 s) and the utterance is transcribed with that language's pack. Output in a script none of our languages use (e.g. Japanese) is rejected and the fallback languages are tried. routeAs sends a language to another language's pack (Urdu → the Hindi/Urdu-capable Dolphin pack).

tier1._comment: On Android the OS engine is Google's recogniser; on iOS Apple Speech; on web the browser's SpeechRecognition.

tier2._comment: Verified on generated speech (docs/TEST-REPORT.md): Hindi -> Dolphin (fast, WER 0.00 on test sentences); Malayalam -> Dolphin writes Tamil, Omnilingual is correct; Gujarati -> both fine, Omnilingual cleaner; English -> Whisper base.en (Dolphin returns nothing). Change any mapping here without a code change.

tier3._comment: backendUrl is normally injected by the host app at runtime (the test app takes it from the UI or its .env). Leave empty to disable tier 3.

tts._comment: voicePolicy: OS_FIRST (1→2→3), CONSISTENT (2→3→1: same voice everywhere), DEVICE_ONLY (1→2), HOSTED_FIRST (3→1→2), HOSTED_ONLY (3), ORDER

packs._comment: Model packs for tier 2. The SDK merges catalogInline with the remote catalog at catalogUrl (remote wins). Each pack lists individual files with sha256, so downloads are resumable and verifiable; packs can also be a single .zip.
